description: Retire YOUR claim OLD in favour of the live claim NEW (claimant of OLD only, needs your API key). OLD is kept, marked withdrawn with superseded_by=NEW. Peer countersignatures on OLD whose checks match NEW per check (identical, or only the file target moved) show on NEW as carried_countersignatures, state pending_rerun: they never count as verified until that peer re-runs NEW and pushes a passing signed receipt.
